name: Godavari River Bathing Ghats
description: Sacred riverbank where Godavari flows as Dakshina Vahini. Host to Pushkarams, holy dips, and Teppotsavam swan boat festival.

name: Parnasala
description: Sacred Ramayana site where Lord Rama, Seetha, and Lakshmana lived during exile and golden deer (Maricha) incident occurred.

name: Mithila Stadium (Kalyana Mandapam)
description: Massive open-air pavilion venue for the annual Sri Rama Navami Sree Seetha Ramachandra Swamy Thiru Kalyanotsavam.

name: Ramadasu Dhyana Mandiram
description: Dedicated meditation hall showcasing Bhakta Ramadasu's life, keertanas, and historical 17th-century Ramatanka gold coins.

name: Bhadra Temple (Foothill Shrine)
description: Shrine dedicated to Bhadra Maharshi where daily foothill Abhishekam is performed.
